empty.title: Your space is empty
empty.description: Upload a file or create your first folder. You can also drag and drop files into this area.

shell.navigationDescription: Navigate to the main areas of Qloud.

details.title: Details
details.emptyDescription: Select a file or folder to see its information, versions, and sharing access.

placeholder.recent: Recent content will be implemented in M2-09.
placeholder.shared: Shared content will be implemented in M5-05.
placeholder.trash: Trash content will be implemented in M4-03.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist or has moved.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.description: An unexpected error occurred while showing this page. Try reloading, or go back to Drive.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Sign in to open your Drive.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.description: Sign up for free to store and share files.
signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, not too similar to your email.
signup.successDescription: We sent a verification email to {{email}}. You can use Drive right away; some features, such as uploading, need a verified email.

verify.successDescription: Thank you! Your email address is verified.
verify.errorDescription: This link is invalid, already used, or expired. If you verified your email before, there is nothing more to do.

reset.requestDescription: Enter the email of your account and we will send you a link to reset your password.
reset.sentDescription: If {{email}} has a Qloud account, a password reset link will arrive in a few minutes.
reset.newPasswordDescription: Choose a new password for your Qloud account.
reset.doneDescription: Your password is updated and every earlier session was signed out.

oauth.failed: Could not sign in with this account. Please try again.
oauth.emailInUse: This email already has a Qloud account. Sign in with your password, then link the account in Settings.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.emailTaken: This email is already used by another account.
errors.captchaInvalid: Bot verification failed. Please try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.signupClosed: Sign-up is not open at the moment.
errors.accountUnavailable: This account cannot be signed in to.
errors.invalidLink: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

sessionError.title: Cannot reach the server
sessionError.description: Your session could not be checked. Check your connection and try again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.displayNameHint: Shown to people you share files with.
profile.saveFailed: The display name could not be saved. Please try again.

preferences.title: Language and appearance
preferences.description: Applied at once and follows your account to every browser.

password.changeDescription: Other sessions will be signed out; this one stays.
password.setDescription: Your account signs in with Google/GitHub. Set a password to sign in with your email, and to be able to unlink accounts.

linked.title: Linked accounts
linked.description: Sign in quickly with Google or GitHub.
linked.none: Signing in with Google or GitHub is not enabled.
linked.connectFailed: The account could not be linked. It may already belong to another user.
linked.loadFailed: Linked accounts could not be loaded.
